comment: Mt. Moon B2F fossil choice (pokered MtMoonB2F Super Nerd script). Every say line is an exact entry label from data/dialogue_database.json group MtMoonB2F; the same labels are the bridge's TEXT_MTMOONB2F_SUPER_NERD / _THEN_THIS_IS_MINE / _DOME_FOSSIL / _HELIX_FOSSIL lists. Battle identity = data/trainers.json SUPER_NERD party 2 (the bound MtMoonB2F placement's own party_index), species only - the difficulty layer builds it. The fossil pick is host UI feeding step data, exactly like the Oak fixture's picks: the host sets ONE transient story flag, mt_moon_pick_dome or mt_moon_pick_helix, from the pick screen before running this script; the prompt line and the grant for the unpicked fossil are skipped by step modifiers. The source's obtain-fanfare line (_MtMoonB2FReceivedFossilText) is not a say step: the give_item step IS the grant (the fanfare text carries an engine-filled [wStringBuffer] name slot). Losing the battle ends the script with nothing granted and no completion flag, so the beat can be retried; the win path sets mt_moon_fossil_taken, which the requires block forbids on replay.
